messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: nccl_comm_timeout on tp4-serving-prod cluster — severity: P1. job_id=svc-gen-4821 ranks=8

ashley: acked. i'm grabbing oncall. seeing customer errors (rate ~8% 503s) from hosted endpoint.

jordan-sre: i'm on call. initial check: one pod restarted repeatedly with OOM and CUDA Xid 79 in dmesg. other ranks report NCCL communicator aborts. attaching quick logs.

eng-runtime: paste of container logs for pod svc-gen-4821-0:
```
[2026-03-14T15:12:03Z] runtime: Alloc failed: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-14T15:12:03Z] runtime: CUDA error: driver shutting down (Xid 79)
[2026-03-14T15:12:03Z] nccl: NCCL WARN Call to recv/accept failed: Unreachable
[2026-03-14T15:12:05Z] nccl: NCCL ERROR AllReduce failed: ret = 11
```

matt-dev: thanks. i also see in other ranks: `NCCL WARN Unhandled SystemError: communicator aborted` followed by `MPI: failed to connect` style logs.

jordan-sre: hypothesis: intermittent GPU OOM on one rank triggers driver reset, leading to communicator teardown and whole job hung/restarted. looks like TP4 config doesn't have resilient fallback.

ops-lee: k8s snapshot: pods svc-gen-4821-0..7. pod-3 on node gnode-14 shows restart_count=4. node gnode-14 dmesg has multiple Xid.\n
ashley: customer impact: several active requests failed for ~2 min windows. CS flagging multiple customers complaining about timeouts. tagging @cs-ana to coordinate notices.

cs-ana: got it — i'll draft a short blurb for affected customers with root-cause: transient GPU OOM causing model restart and degraded throughput. ETA for update?

jordan-sre: immediate mitigation plan (live):
1) isolate node gnode-14 (cordon) -> prevent scheduling new pods.
2) scale down job replica count to reduce pressure and let hot restarts finish: `kubectl scale deployment svc-gen-4821 --replicas=4`
3) apply runtime hotpatch to reduce per-device memory usage: set ENV `MODEL_MAX_BATCH=4` and `TP_DEGREE=2` for a rollout variant, then route a fraction of traffic to fallback replica.
4) enable NCCL debug env and increase communicator timeout for better retries: `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_TIMEOUT=300000`

eng-runtime: i'm preparing a rolling config patch. command i'll run: 
```
kubectl set env deployment/svc-gen-4821 MODEL_MAX_BATCH=4 TP_DEGREE=2 --record
kubectl set env deployment/svc-gen-4821 NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_TIMEOUT=300000
```
I will also change the routing policy in console to send 20% traffic to `svc-gen-4821-fallback`.

matt-dev: quick note — changing TP_DEGREE requires model variant compatible with tp2. we have a prebuilt tp2 image `redwood/svc-gen:tp2-20260301` that should be safe. i'll spin it as `svc-gen-4821-fallback`.

jordan-sre: doing the cordon+drain on gnode-14 now. draining gracefully with `--delete-local-data --force=false`.

ops-lee: node cordoned. draining completed on pods from this deployment. restart loop stopped on that node.

eng-runtime: patch applied and fallback deployment created: `svc-gen-4821-fallback` now running 4 replicas (tp2 image). routing adjusted to 20%. initial telemetry: error rate dropped from 8% -> 3% in the last 30s.

ashley: nice. continuing to monitor. CS: please hold the external blurb until we confirm stability for 15 mins.

cs-ana: will wait for confirmation. prepping message template in case we need to escalate.

jordan-sre: logs now show fewer NCCL aborts. we'll keep NCCL_DEBUG enabled to capture traces for postmortem. action items:
- (jordan-sre) collect driver and dmesg logs from gnode-14 and upload to incident folder.
- (matt-dev) run a stress test on tp2 variant to ensure memory headroom.
- (eng-runtime) add automatic fallback route in console for replica-level failures (canary to fallback).
- (ops-lee) schedule maintenance on gnode-14 to repro and check hardware.

matt-dev: i'll also add an immediate mitigation to server runtime: lower default batch size for TP4 jobs to avoid single-rank OOMs until we have quantization/packing improvements.

ashley: thanks all. i'll keep this thread for handoff. if anything regresses ping @jordan-sre and i'll page. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and routed to oncall. severity P1 -> monitoring escalations suppressed while mitigation in place.

jordan-sre: last update (checkpoint): 15:14Z error rate stable at 1.2%, fallback serving handling most traffic, cordoned node isolated. moving to mitigation state — will update in postmortem with timeline and RCA.

ashley: closing live pager. leaving thread open for postmortem notes and action tracking.
